description: Get the compliance report for one chat bot: takes `targetRef` (required, from listDigitalComplianceAudits) and optional `sector`. Returns the same report as the voice compliance report (getComplianceReportByPhone), built from the latest run of each catalogue test against that bot, plus `channel` and `targetRef`. Use when: the user asks whether a chat bot is compliant or which compliance checks it fails. Read-only. Needs digital:read. Only your workspace's runs are read.

sector.description: Restrict the catalogue to tests applicable to this sector.

targetRef.description:
The target to report on, e.g. `acme/billing-bot`.

A QUERY parameter rather than a path parameter because a targetRef
contains slashes. An HTTP API path parameter matches one segment, and
percent-encoding does not help — the gateway decodes `%2F` before
routing, so the request arrives as several segments and matches no
route. Voice's `{phoneNumber}` works only because E.164 has no slashes.

name: getDigitalComplianceAudit

outputSchema.description:
Same shape as the voice compliance report, plus `channel` and
`targetRef`.

title: Get Digital Compliance Audit
